title: Rune Construction cost, complexity, stability and progression contract
authority_note: The retained sources explicitly provide mana, charges, materials, time/DC, enchanting/rune engraving, resistance/counterspell, fatigue/Overreach and Resonance precedents, but they do not provide a universal arbitrary-rune cost formula, universal progression prices, or final balance thresholds. This contract therefore separates structural complexity, resource adapters, composition-stability load and later power/balance calibration. All new thresholds here are governed proposal-stage design unless a field explicitly says source_explicit.

structural_complexity.name: Structural Complexity Index
structural_complexity.purpose: Explain authoring/cognitive complexity and support progression/usability warnings without measuring power.

bands.ui: show complexity warning plus step-by-step explanation
show high-complexity warning, decomposition suggestion and full linear explanation

resource_adapter_contract.rule: Rune Construction never invents one universal cost. It requests typed values/references from the owning execution, spellcasting, crafting, item, campaign or setting rules and reports unresolved inputs explicitly.
resource_adapter_contract.authoritative_rule: If an owning rule says an adapter is required for the selected execution context, authoritative execution/crafting cannot substitute a guessed or default numeric value when that adapter is unresolved.

composition_stability.name: Composition Stability Load
composition_stability.purpose: Provide an explainable structural risk signal informed by Scripts/Macros Resonance and crafting-failure precedent; it is not itself a failure probability or damage formula.
composition_stability.formula: CSL = with_count + when_count + if_count + max(0,link_count-1) + max(0,unique_payload_count-1) + max(0,max_group_depth-2) + prepared_macro_context

bands.ui: show prominent stability warning and mitigation/counterplay hooks
require explicit stability review before authoritative use when the owning rules require such review

composition_stability.final_resonance_calibration: PPIA-11 or explicitly adopted owning magic rules

counterplay_hooks.purpose: Expose permission-safe atom/payload/shape/trigger facts to an owning recognition rule.
Route payload/effect resistance to adopted runtime rules.
Route cast/prepared-macro interruption to adopted counterspell/disruption rules.
Allow an owning rule to target LINK/synchronization channels without redefining that rule here.
Allow an owning rule to suppress or invalidate WHEN/IF trigger inputs.
Route persistent inscription/binding removal to adopted enchanting/disenchanting rules.

crafting_and_inscription_interface.owner_boundary: PPIA-03 retains Item Definition/instance ownership; PPIA-07 owns only rune-extension semantics and validation.
crafting_and_inscription_interface.workbench_precedent: Screen Design V08 / SD-707 Enchanting & Enhancement
crafting_and_inscription_interface.recovery_rule: Check operation/current-version state before retrying an ambiguous authoritative write; reuse the same operation_id and never duplicate an inscription.

progression_contract.authority: proposal_candidate_for_teachability; exact XP/perk prices remain source-scoped or future governed values

bands.recommended_scope: small sequential constructions, shaping, movement, binding and basic inscription
explicit grouping, parallel composition, triggers, conditions and prepared logic
advanced/expert composition, synchronization/LINK-heavy designs, deep inspection and decomposition

recommended_minimum_band_rules: Start from SCI: simple->0, standard->1, advanced->2, expert->3.
WHEN or IF requires at least band 2.
prepared-macro execution requires at least band 2.
two or more LINK atoms requires at least band 3.
The final recommended band is the maximum of applicable rules.
